fato_historico: 1299: According to Edward Gibbon, Osman I invades the territory of Nicomedia for the first time, usually considered to be the founding day of the Ottoman state.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to build your personal empire today, much like the legendary beginnings of a vast kingdom starting from a single, bold step. It is a good time to consider the structures in your life that foster beauty and peace. You may find that your diplomatic grace opens doors that were previously firmly closed.
frase_do_dia: Build your inner world with the delicate strength of a rising morning star.
significado_numero: The number of visionary leadership and building lasting foundations with grace.
conselho: Plant the seeds of your dreams today; your patience will surely bloom.
